candidates.title: Kenya NCAJ report: ~31% of convicted prisoners are serving sentences for sexual offences; CJ Koome urges prevention, rehabilitation and reforms on tech-facilitated sexual abuse
candidates.snippet: Nyakundi Report (@NyakundiReport): A new National Council on the Administration of Justice (NCAJ) report shows 11,108 of approximately 37,000 convicted prisoners in Kenya are serving sentences for sexual offences — about 31% of the convicted prison population. The report flags the growing number of sexual-offence cases and gaps in rehabilitation. Chief Justice Martha Koome has called for stronger prevention, improved rehabilitation and legal reforms to address emerging tech-facilitated offences including cyberstalking, sextortion and deepfake pornography.
